description: This file defines the ElementTrackingStore class, a wrapper around a key-value store (KVStore) used in Apache Spark to track elements of specific types, trigger actions upon reaching thresholds, and manage asynchronous tasks related to data storage and flushing. It includes trigger management, asynchronous execution, and store interaction functionalities.

classes.name: ElementTrackingStore
classes.description: A key-value store wrapper that tracks element counts, triggers actions at thresholds, and manages asynchronous tasks within Spark.

methods.name: addTrigger
methods.description: Registers a trigger to fire when the number of elements of a specific type reaches a threshold.

methods.name: onFlush
methods.description: Adds an action to be executed synchronously before the store is flushed or closed.

methods.name: doAsync
methods.description: Enqueues an asynchronous task to run on a separate thread or the calling thread based on configuration.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes an element to the store and optionally fires triggers if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the store, optionally closing the underlying parent store, and executes flush triggers.
